The '''Sentient Greatsword''' is a type of [[Weapons|Weapon]].

It is the direct Upgrade of the [[Living Sword]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Sentient Weapons evolve from their craftable Living counterpart after having dealt 50,000 damage.

== ''Usage'' ==

The Sentient Greatsword is a Melee Weapon. Its Attack Range, in horizontal, is of 3 Blocks. In vertical, it is 8 Block.

Each time it is swung, it performs a sweeping attack (though only visually if airborne or the attack cooldown is still up) and has a chance to apply the [[Bleeding|Bleeding II]] Effect to the struck mob. 

== ''Trivia'' ==
*The Sentient Greatsword was inspired by the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Armadyl_godsword Armadyl Godsword] and [https://runescape.wiki/w/Saradomin_godsword Saradomin Godsword], both from Runescape.
